meta.title: Specific Volume Converter — Convert Cubic meter/kilogram and More
meta.description: Free specific volume converter for 4+ units including Cubic meter/kilogram, Cubic centimeter/gram, Liter/kilogram. Instant, accurate, browser-based.

content.intro: m³/kg, cm³/g, ft³/lb. Convert between 4 specific volume units instantly, with engineering-grade precision and no signup required.
content.result_section: Pick any two units below to convert between them. The base unit for specific volume in this tool is **m3kg**; every conversion routes through it for consistency.
content.formula_section: Most specific volume conversions are a single multiplication by a fixed factor. Temperature is the notable exception — it uses additive offsets, not just multiplication. The converter handles both transparently.
content.conversion_table:
| Unit | Symbol |
| --- | --- |
| Cubic meter/kilogram | m³/kg |
| Cubic centimeter/gram | cm³/g |
| Liter/kilogram | L/kg |
| Cubic foot/pound | ft³/lb |
content.use_cases:
- Reading datasheets where SI and imperial units appear side by side.
- Cross-checking CAD drawings against fabrication specs in a different system.
- Converting torque, pressure, or stress values for procurement.
- Translating field measurements into engineering reports.
- Spec'ing parts from international suppliers.
content.tips:
Bookmark the conversions you use most — each pair has its own dedicated page with formulas, a lookup table, and FAQs.

When working with derived units (area, volume), remember the factor scales with the dimension: a length factor f becomes f² for area and f³ for volume.
content.faq:
**Q:** How accurate is this specific volume converter?
**A:** It uses 4 canonical unit definitions and 12-digit precision constants.

**Q:** Is it free?
**A:** Yes — completely free, no signup, no limits.

**Q:** Which units are supported?
**A:** Cubic meter/kilogram (m³/kg), Cubic centimeter/gram (cm³/g), Liter/kilogram (L/kg), Cubic foot/pound (ft³/lb).
